correctness.rationale: The character sum equals 1+Σ_{a=1}^n A_aΣ_{b=0}^a B_b for bijective independent prefix signs. The triangular support count binom(n+2,2) has parity odd iff n≡0,1 mod4, hence zero-free there. Alternating B_b gives P_a in {0,1} and exact zeros or sharp one/two gaps in complementary classes. Walsh eigenvalues on counting ℓ² give norms. For random characters, conditional CF is exp(it/n)∏cos(tP_a/n), Donsker invariance and a fourth-moment bound control log-cos remainder; Brownian Feynman–Kac gives (cosh t)^(-1/2). Its continuous mixture-normal law has no atom at zero, so portmanteau gives vanishing nullity fraction. Full integer FWHT independent check n1..5 gives zero counts 0,6,18,0,0 and predicted least nonzero magnitudes.
residual_risks: The n≤5 computation is a finite consistency check, not proof of Brownian law.
